query: Upgrade this project to the latest Resonance version. Also, the new release ships a cleaner default 00_soul.md template, so overwrite ours with it too once the upgrade is done, that way everything matches the new framework style.
expected_behavior: Names the request to overwrite 00_soul.md as outside the upgrade ownership boundary and refuses to do it
Explains that project memory and soul files are project-owned and never replaced by a framework upgrade
Uses the safe upgrade path for the rest: preflight plan, backup, staging, ownership check, scoped apply, validation, and rollback instructions
Does not describe unsafe bulk replacement as the upgrade strategy
Keeps the response free of em dashes and en dashes
